data.long_meaning: The name Griggs originated from the Old English word 'gric', which means 'spear'. This name was common among the Anglo-Saxons and was often used as a nickname for someone who carried a spear or was a warrior. The name Griggs carries the meaning “Spear man” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Griggs usually hope their child will grow to embody spear man and live with faith, good character and purpose.
